description: Plan a 1-7 day London sightseeing trip: groups places into days by area, in walking order, with the time each visit takes and the walks or Tube hops between them. Give the places the person wants, or interests to pick the best-loved ones. Returns the days plus a link to the interactive plan on the London Tourist Map (map, opening hours for their dates, lunch stops, booking checklist and printable PDF).

interests.description: Themes to fill the days with: hidden_gems, editors_picks, only_here, nature, thrills, quirky, romantic, family, rainy_day, after_dark, or words like "museums", "markets", "free".

pace.description: How full the days are (default normal).

places.description: Places they want to see, by name.

start_date.description: First day of the trip (YYYY-MM-DD), to avoid closed days.

name: plan_london_trip
title: Plan a London trip
